description: Frame-by-frame growth: a round seed of seed_size, meshed at edge_length, grows in a solver. Every frame each point moves out by rate × its growth, mostly away from the centre and partly along its normal; the growth is uneven by lumpiness, from a fractal noise read on the seed's own directions (so a knob keeps growing where it started; seed moves the knobs), and the underside barely grows, so the form sits on its base. Then the surface is relaxed (Taubin, no shrinking) and remeshed to edge_length again, so it stays evenly meshed; past about 20,000 triangles the edges lengthen to keep the cook light. The form sits on the ground in a pale coral material. Cook any frame (24 fps): frame 1 is the seed.

seed_size.label: seed size
seed_size.desc: diameter of the round seed it grows from (m)

rate.label: rate
rate.desc: how far the surface grows each frame (m)

lumpiness.label: lumpiness
lumpiness.desc: how unevenly it grows: 0 swells like a balloon, 1 throws out knobs

edge_length.label: edge length
edge_length.desc: edge length the surface keeps as it grows (m); longer only past about 20,000 triangles

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: random seed of where the knobs come out

seed_mesh.note: the seed at edge_length; finer on a seed too small for it (4 edges across, never below 0.35 × edge_length), coarser past about 20,000 triangles

anchor.note: each point remembers its direction on the seed: the growth noise is read there, so knobs stay put as the form grows

area.note: surface area of the last frame, for the triangle budget

even.note: back to edge_length (sqrt(area / 6400) keeps it under about 20,000 triangles)

grows.note: the form holds at least the seed's volume (1e-6: float rounding only; at frame 1 the form is the seed)

form.label: Form
form.description: The form at the current frame: one closed, outward-facing triangle mesh with edges of about edge_length, sitting on the ground, in a pale coral material.
